parts.name: pupil
parts.hint: The black opening in the middle that lets the light in.

parts.name: lens
parts.hint: The clear, bendable disc that focuses light onto the back of the eye.

parts.name: iris
parts.hint: The coloured ring that makes the black opening bigger or smaller.

parts.name: cornea
parts.hint: The clear, curved window at the very front that starts bending the light.

parts.name: aqueous humour
parts.hint: The watery fluid filling the space just behind the clear front window.

parts.name: ciliary body
parts.hint: The ring of muscle that pulls on the lens to change its shape.

parts.name: optic nerve
parts.hint: The cable that carries the picture from the eye to the brain.

parts.name: vitreous humour
parts.hint: The clear jelly that fills the big ball of the eye and keeps its shape.

parts.name: retina
parts.hint: The thin layer at the back that catches the light — home of the rods and cones.

parts.name: choroid
parts.hint: The blood-rich layer between the white coat and the light-catching layer, feeding the back of the eye.

parts.name: sclera
parts.hint: The tough outer coat — the white of the eye.

parts.name: eye muscles
parts.hint: The straps on the outside that turn the eyeball to look up, down and around.

parts.name: eyelids
parts.hint: The folds of skin that close over the front when you blink.
